title: Debug mode enabled (xml) — review required
description: Debug behavior is switched on in xml: <customErrors mode="Off" />. Debug modes expose tracebacks, consoles, or verbose errors to whoever can reach the service. This lexical rule flags the switch; the reviewer confirms it is local-only or turns it off.
remediation: Gate the switch on RemoteOnly errors and default it off.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the switch regardless of environment. Generic debug=true forms are separate rules.
